import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Group data by district and count number of dogs
district_data = df.groupby('KreisLang').agg({'AnzHunde': 'sum'}).reset_index()

# Order the data by number of dogs
district_data = district_data.sort_values(by='AnzHunde', ascending=False)

# Set the plot style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
barplot = sns.barplot(x='AnzHunde', y='KreisLang', data=district_data, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
barplot.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
barplot.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=12)
barplot.set_title('Number of Registered Dogs by District in Zurich', fontsize=16)

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Group data by district and count number of dogs
district_data = df.groupby('KreisLang').agg({'AnzHunde': 'sum'}).reset_index()

# Order the data by number of dogs
district_data = district_data.sort_values(by='AnzHunde', ascending=False)

# Set the plot style
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
barplot = sns.barplot(x='AnzHunde', y='KreisLang', data=district_data, palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
barplot.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
barplot.set_ylabel('District', fontsize=12)
barplot.set_title('Number of Registered Dogs by District in Zurich', fontsize=16)

# Save the plot to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
